definitions.explanation: A sea with high waves and strong winds, dangerous to sail on. Also used figuratively for a harsh environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本海|にほんかい}→日本海：30773_nihonkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荒海|あらうみ}だ。
examples.english: The Sea of Japan is rough in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒海|あらうみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧もまれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A small boat was being tossed about on the rough sea.

examples.japanese: {荒海|あらうみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{漁|りょう}→漁：31785_ryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the sight of fishermen going out on the rough sea to fish.

notes:
⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧ (rough, violent) + ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧. A somewhat literary word; in conversation, ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}れている→荒れる：04577_areru⟧ (the sea is rough) is more usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荒海|あらうみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}す→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧: to set out on a rough sea (figuratively, into a harsh world)
- {荒海|あらうみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧もまれる: to be tossed about by rough seas
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荒海|あらうみ}: the stormy seas of life

CULTURAL NOTE:
Bashō's haiku {荒海|あらうみ}や{佐渡|さど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧たふ{天|あま}の{河|がわ} (the rough sea; stretching over to Sado, the Milky Way) from ⟦{奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち}→奥の細道：31063_okunohosomichi⟧ is the best-known use of the word.
